headline: Final approval for Coastal Oaks plan to turn 12 Pearl Street warehouse into 20 residential units
summary: The three-story building will have two on-site parking spaces and one ADA drop-off space. An agreement with Premium Parking covers the 20 needed spaces at the Pearl Street parking garage, and the applicant must secure off-street parking before occupancy if that agreement ends. Separately, a final site plan for a 7,500 square foot building for TNT leasing at three Digital Drive was approved after an earlier approval lapsed.
decisions: Approved unanimously the final subdivision and site plan for Coastal Oaks to convert 12 Pearl Street into 20 residential units, with stormwater and parking waivers.
Approved unanimously the final site plan for TNT leasing's 7,500 square foot building at three Digital Drive, with a contour waiver.
discussion: Pearl Street garage parking: Members asked whether the garage has room during snowstorms. Staff said the garage has 644 stalls and 445 unreserved permits sold, and that garages usually sell 10 to 20 percent more permits than stalls.
Retaining wall condition: Members said the wall between 10 and 12 Pearl Street has not yet been reviewed by an engineer. They said it should be a priority before an occupancy permit is issued.

TNT tenant uses: Members asked how the city would control tenant uses in the building. Staff said fire and code enforcement sign off on each tenant before occupancy, and staff will follow up on outdoor storage such as mulch.

Annual committee report: Members discussed the mayor's 2026 committee report, due November 18, 2026. Ideas included ordinance changes, a workshop on conditional uses, and starting the next comprehensive plan sooner.
